title: Writing / Tone / Context
slide_intent: Respond differently to success and setbacks so feedback acknowledges progress without discouraging continued effort.
strategic_value: Concise celebration and supportive correction can make Duolingo’s product feedback feel responsive to the learner.
demonstration: Success examples appear above setback examples, each contrasting preferred concise copy with formal or excessive alternatives.
practical_value: Choose celebration for success and a short helpful next step for a setback.

content_islands.name: Guidance column
content_islands.spec: Place the Context heading and product-moment explanation at left.

content_islands.name: Worked examples
content_islands.spec: Divide the right panel into success and setback groups, each with a rule followed by preferred and rejected messages.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text explains that learners should be celebrated when they succeed and supported when they stumble so they keep going.
reference_purposes.Expression: The product messages demonstrate cheerful and supportive registers.
reference_purposes.Application: The paired success and setback examples show how to adapt feedback.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The setback guidance warns against overdoing reassurance.

ingredient.name: Product-feedback tone
ingredient.role: Acknowledge the outcome while encouraging continuation.
ingredient.application: Celebrate success; keep setback messages friendly, helpful and concise.
ingredient.scope: Historical official guidelines from the 2024–2025 archived snapshot; this records the displayed guidance, not current Duolingo product behavior.
